_what: Fantasy Fancy Dress, the shop behind the Dopamine Dress-Up Den, Helen Edgar's ask, 2026-10-15: faery wings in different sizes and colours, jewellery, beads and rings, onesies, tiger, bear, dragon and unicorn dress-up suits, and animal ears, tails and paws. Everything here is worn by a bodymind drawn at the Bodymind Booth (Helen's answer: your bodymind), so none of it hangs on the Den's valet stand; avatar.js draws every piece from the body it is on, and tools/make-fancy-dress.py builds the shop's rails from this file.
_chimera: THE CHIMERA ONESIE, a request from our community for Halloween (2026-10-28): a onesie made after one of your chimeras from Chimera Obscura, in the colours of the animal that gave it its colours, with the ears, tail, markings and back of the animals that gave those. A piece with `chimera` true gets a chooser under its rail, and its look carries the chimera's parts, which avatar.js and the server's cleanLook() both check as a kept chimera is checked. The chimera comes from Chimera Obscura's address (#chimera=), from the chimeras on its wall, or from the ones you kept, read by strip.js when you press for them; nothing is kept here. Its print and colours are the chimera's, so the rail's own are set aside while it is on.
_words: Every piece says how it feels and how it goes on and comes off, the Den's rule, and the tool reads make-dressup.py's sweeps over every word here. Our voice never says costume: it is a dress-up suit, an outfit or fancy dress.
_start: start is what a rail's selects open on when that piece is picked: a print and a colourway out of the Den's own lists, a first suggestion and nothing more. Everything comes in every print and every colourway.

garments.name: Dragonfly wings
garments.feel: Four narrow wings, light as anything, and small enough not to catch on a doorway.
garments.on: Two soft loops over the shoulders. Nothing goes round the chest.

garments.name: Butterfly wings
garments.feel: Gauzy and a little stiff at the edges, so they hold their shape.
garments.on: Two soft loops over the shoulders, and off the same way.

garments.name: Moth wings
garments.feel: Big, soft and velvety, with a scalloped edge you can run a finger along.
garments.on: Loops over the shoulders, wide enough to shrug off.

garments.name: Great faery wings
garments.feel: The biggest: four long panels from above your head to below your hips, sheer and floaty.
garments.on: Loops over the shoulders. They fold flat to sit back in a chair.

garments.name: Bat wings
garments.feel: Stretchy fabric over soft ribs that fold up like an umbrella, with a scalloped edge.
garments.on: Two soft loops over the shoulders. They fold flat to sit back in a chair.

garments.name: Cat ears
garments.feel: Two small pointed felt ears on a soft covered band.
garments.on: The band slips on over your hair and off again; nothing pinches behind the ears.

garments.name: Fox ears
garments.feel: Tall pointed ears with fluffy insides.
garments.on: On a soft covered band that slips on and off.

garments.name: Bunny ears
garments.feel: Long floppy ears that bend wherever you push them.
garments.on: On a soft covered band that slips on and off.

garments.name: Bear ears
garments.feel: Two round fuzzy ears, soft as a teddy's.
garments.on: On a soft covered band that slips on and off.

garments.name: Mouse ears
garments.feel: Two big round ears, light and a little bit silly.
garments.on: On a soft covered band that slips on and off.

garments.name: Wolf ears
garments.feel: Tall furry ears with a tuft at each tip and pale fluff inside.
garments.on: On a soft covered band that slips on and off.

garments.name: Bat ears
garments.feel: Big pointed ears that stick out to the sides, smooth on the inside.
garments.on: On a soft covered band that slips on and off.

garments.name: Vampire fangs
garments.feel: Two small soft fangs that clip over your own teeth and do not get in the way of talking.
garments.on: Press on and pull off. No glue.

garments.name: Clown face paint
garments.feel: A round red nose, rosy cheeks and a big painted smile.
garments.on: The nose is soft foam on a clip. The paint is water based and washes off with warm water.

garments.name: Whisker face paint
garments.feel: Whiskers drawn out over the cheeks and a dot on the tip of the nose.
garments.on: Water based paint that washes off with warm water.

garments.name: Skull face paint
garments.feel: A pale face, dark rings round the eyes, a dark nose and teeth drawn over the lips.
garments.on: Water based paint that washes off with warm water.

garments.name: Cat tail
garments.feel: Long and soft, with a bend in the wire so it curls up at the end.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips.

garments.name: Fox tail
garments.feel: Bushy and fluffy, with a pale tip.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips.

garments.name: Bunny tail
garments.feel: A round fluffy pompom you can squeeze.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips.

garments.name: Bear tail
garments.feel: A short fuzzy stub, hardly there at all.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips.

garments.name: Dragon tail
garments.feel: Long, stuffed and squashy, with soft spikes down the top, and it trails on the floor.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips. Sitting down, it lies to one side.

garments.name: Unicorn tail
garments.feel: Long silky strands that swish when you move.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips.

garments.name: Wolf tail
garments.feel: Long and bushy, hanging low, with a dark tip.
garments.on: Clips on at the back of a waistband and unclips.

garments.name: Cat paws
garments.feel: Fluffy mitts with soft pads underneath.
garments.on: They slide on and off, and the fingers are free underneath.

garments.name: Bear paws
garments.feel: Big furry mitts with felt claws that are not sharp at all.
garments.on: They slide on and off, and the fingers are free underneath.

garments.name: Dragon claws
garments.feel: Scaly-printed soft gloves with stuffed felt claws.
garments.on: They slide on and off, and the fingers are free underneath.

garments.name: Wolf claws
garments.feel: Furry mitts with four soft felt claws each.
garments.on: They slide on and off, and the fingers are free underneath.

garments.name: Bead necklace
garments.feel: Small smooth beads that click a little when you move.
garments.on: Goes over your head. No clasp to find.

garments.name: Chunky beads
garments.feel: Big wooden beads, heavy enough to fiddle with.
garments.on: Goes over your head. No clasp to find.

garments.name: Pendant
garments.feel: A fine chain and one smooth stone that warms up as you wear it.
garments.on: A big clasp at the front, easy to open.

garments.name: Velvet choker
garments.feel: A soft velvet band, as loose as you like.
garments.on: Fastens with a hook and loop at the back, and comes off with one pull.

garments.name: Neck bolts
garments.feel: Two light foam bolts, one each side of the neck, on a soft band.
garments.on: The band fastens with a hook and loop and comes off with one pull.

garments.name: Spiderweb choker
garments.feel: A soft lace band like a spiderweb, with a little spider at the front.
garments.on: Fastens with a hook and loop at the back, and comes off with one pull.

garments.name: Rings
garments.feel: Smooth bands with nothing to catch, on whichever fingers you like.
garments.on: Slide on and off. They open a little, so none of them is tight.

garments.name: Bead bracelets
garments.feel: A stack of stretchy beads to roll round your wrist.
garments.on: Stretch over your hand.

garments.name: Bangles
garments.feel: Smooth hoops that slide and clink together.
garments.on: Slip over your hand.

garments.name: Spider rings
garments.feel: Little soft spiders with bendy legs that sit on your fingers.
garments.on: Slide on and off. The bands stretch, so none of them is tight.

garments.name: Bone bangles
garments.feel: Smooth hoops strung with little carved bones that clack together.
garments.on: Slip over your hand.

garments.name: Wizard staff
garments.feel: A long light staff, smooth to hold, with a stone set in the top.
garments.on: Hold it, or lean it on your shoulder. If your hands are full, it goes on a strap across your back.

garments.name: Witch broom
garments.feel: A light broom with a bundle of soft straw at the end.
garments.on: Hold it, or sling it across your back on its strap when your hands are full.

garments.name: Magic wand
garments.feel: A short smooth wand with a star on the end.
garments.on: Hold it, or tuck it into the cord at your hip.

garments.name: Lantern
garments.feel: A little lantern with a warm window that stays lit and never flickers.
garments.on: Hold it by its handle, or hang it from the cord at your hip.

garments.name: Treat bucket
garments.feel: A round pumpkin bucket with a grin, light even when it is full.
garments.on: Hold it by its handle, or hang it from the cord at your hip.

garments.name: Onesie
garments.feel: Brushed fleece all over, roomy, with a hood and soft cuffs.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull you can find without looking.

garments.name: Tiger suit
garments.feel: Soft fleece with stripes, round ears on the hood, and room to curl up.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull.

garments.name: Bear suit
garments.feel: Thick and cuddly, with a pale belly and round ears on the hood.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull.

garments.name: Dragon suit
garments.feel: Soft fleece with a scaly belly and floppy spikes over the hood.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull.

garments.name: Unicorn suit
garments.feel: Soft fleece, a stuffed gold horn on the hood and a mane down one side.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull.

garments.name: Chimera onesie
garments.feel: Soft fleece in your chimera's own colours, its ears on the hood, its tail at the back and its markings down the front.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull. Choose which chimera under this rail.

garments.name: Mummy wraps
garments.feel: Soft stretchy bandages wound round and round, with one loose end trailing.
garments.on: A suit with the wraps sewn on, and a zip from the neck to the knee. Nothing is wound tight.

garments.name: Skeleton suit
garments.feel: Soft dark fleece with the bones printed on in pale paint.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull.

garments.name: Ghost suit
garments.feel: A floaty white hooded robe with a wavy hem, light as a sheet but with your face free.
garments.on: Goes on over your head. No fastenings.

garments.name: Pumpkin suit
garments.feel: A round squashy pumpkin middle, soft fleece arms and legs, and a stalk on the hood.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull.

garments.name: Bat suit
garments.feel: Soft fleece with bat ears on the hood and wings from the wrists to the waist.
garments.on: A zip from the neck to the knee, with a big pull. The wings are loose, so your arms move freely.

garments.name: Clown suit
garments.feel: Baggy all over, with a soft ruffled collar and three pompom buttons.
garments.on: A zip up the back with a long pull, and loose cuffs that let your hands out.

garments.name: Pirate outfit
garments.feel: A loose shirt with a deep neck, breeches to the knee and a sash round the middle.
garments.on: The sash ties in a loose knot at the side and the shirt pulls on over your head.

garments.name: Vampire suit
garments.feel: A long-tailed coat, a red waistcoat and a ruffled cravat, all soft.
garments.on: The coat is open at the front, and the cravat is on a hook and loop.
